Your armies in the bubble: tap a province where you have troops and each of your armies appears as a button, with its soldiers and a morale bar (green, amber or red). Tap it to select it: it is also highlighted on the map.
  • Orders: below appear the orders for the selected army: 🎯 Move, 🤖 Automatic, ✂️ Split, 🔗 Merge here, 💰 Plunder and 🧲 Regroup. They are the same as in the panel below the map.
  • 🎯 Move: the bubble closes and a notice at the top of the map asks you to tap the destination province; «Cancel» undoes it.
  • Icons and animations: in Settings you choose the icon style (Game, Line or system emoji) and whether you want a short animation when you earn an achievement, a promotion or a victory.

Games use a single icon style so each thing can be recognized at a glance, without reading. game-icons.net is a free collection of more than 4,000 icons made by volunteer artists and is used in many strategy games.
Game (filled, by default), Line (thin strokes) or your system emoji. When you change it, the page reloads and your game is saved first.
An immediate signal when you achieve something reinforces the feeling of progress: it is a basic idea of game design and of the psychology of learning.
They appear when you earn an achievement, a promotion or a victory. They do not stop the game or cover the buttons; in automatic they turn off on slow devices or with “reduce motion”.
